summary: Retest of the per-account asyncio.Lock login fix. The iteration_7 regression is FIXED. Concurrent correct logins: 10 parallel gave 10x 200 and 20 parallel gave 20x 200, in both pytest and burst_probe.py. Wrong-password bursts stay capped: 40 parallel gave exactly 8x 401 and 32x 429, with and without spoofed XFF. Sequential checks pass: the 9th wrong attempt returns 429, a correct password before the limit resets the counter, and the correct password while locked returns 429. Accounts are independent: 20 wrong logins to A ran in parallel with 10 correct logins to B. B got 10x 200, A got 8x 401 and 12x 429, and afterwards A's correct password returns 429 while B's returns 200. A burst for an unknown email is also capped (8x 401, 22x 429). Full suite: 72/72 pass. UI smoke passes: demo login, open Product Launch (6 cards, 3 columns render), logout returns to the login form.

minor.issue: Logins are serialized per email, so N parallel correct logins for one account take about N times the bcrypt time (about 0.2-0.3s each). This is fine at realistic concurrency.

For an unknown email the handler skips bcrypt, so it answers measurably faster. That allows user enumeration by timing. Optionally run checkpw against a dummy hash. This is pre-existing, low priority.

critical_code_review_comments: account_lock: setdefault, increment and pop are synchronous with no await in between, so the refcounted cleanup is race-free on one event loop. The finally block releases the lock when a request is cancelled.
The stale-key sweep in record_failure now runs at most once every 60s, which resolves the iteration_7 O(n)-per-request concern.
check_throttle runs inside the lock before bcrypt, so a locked account sends back a fast 429 and doesn't use thread-pool time.
The throttle and locks are in memory and per process. They are not shared across multiple workers or replicas.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest in the FOREGROUND, because background jobs are killed when the bash call ends: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<frontend/.env> pytest /app/backend/tests (about 3.2 minutes, xdist -n 2 by default). Editing files under backend/tests triggers a backend hot reload, so wait about 5s. The login testids are login-email-input, login-password-input and login-submit-button. The dashboard uses board-tile-{id} and logout-button.
rca of the issue: The iteration_7 regression (in-flight successes using up throttle slots) is resolved by serializing check, bcrypt and record/clear per email. Each attempt now sees the final outcome of the previous one.
